envelope.description: Guard the gates against a hash conflict before the BUILD hook

body.title: Guard the gates against a hash conflict before the BUILD hook
body.summary: In src/workflow/gates.ts call checkHeadIntegrity at the top of approveArtifactByJsonPath and, in both branches of approveWorkflowTarget, before ensureBuildRecordOnCompletion; call it at the start of reviewArtifactFile in src/workflow/review/run-artifact.ts. A conflicted target goes to skipped[] on the workflow path and raises LifecycleConflictError elsewhere; a head with no stored hash behaves as today.
acceptanceChecks: a BUILD target whose stored hash differs from its content comes back in skipped[] in both branches and its record bytes are unchanged by ensureBuildRecordOnCompletion
approveArtifactByJsonPath and reviewArtifactFile raise LifecycleConflictError before any stamp, and approveArtifactByJsonPath stays synchronous
the existing gates, plan-gate, admit-build, review and build-step tests pass unchanged

tests.name: src/workflow/__tests__/gates-lifecycle-guard.test.ts: approveWorkflowTarget refuses a conflicted BUILD target in both branches before ensureBuildRecordOnCompletion rewrites it
src/workflow/__tests__/gates-lifecycle-guard.test.ts: approveArtifactByJsonPath and reviewArtifactFile refuse a conflicted head before any stamp and an unhashed head is unchanged
